title: Implement schema types (base, nodes, edges)
content:
# Implement Schema Types

Foundation types for OpenTasks. All other Phase 1 work depends on this.

## Deliverables

Create the following files:

### `src/schema/base.ts`
- `BaseNode` interface with all shared fields
- `Anchor` interface for feedback positioning

### `src/schema/nodes.ts`
- `Spec` interface (extends BaseNode, type: 'spec')
- `Issue` interface (extends BaseNode, type: 'issue', status required)
- `Feedback` interface (extends BaseNode, type: 'feedback', target_id required)
- `ExternalNode` interface (extends BaseNode, type: 'external', uri/source required)
- `Node` discriminated union type

### `src/schema/edges.ts`
- `Edge` interface
- `CoreEdgeType`, `ExtendedEdgeType`, `EdgeType` types

### `src/schema/storage.ts`
- `StoredNode` interface (permissive, with index signature)
- `StoredEdge` type alias

### `src/schema/validation.ts`
- Type guards: `isSpec()`, `isIssue()`, `isFeedback()`, `isExternal()`
- `validateNode()` function for storage → application conversion
- `ValidationError` class

### `src/schema/index.ts`
- Re-export all types

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All interfaces match [[s-4l4m]] spec exactly
- [ ] Type guards work correctly with discriminated union
- [ ] `validateNode()` returns typed Node or throws ValidationError
- [ ] Unknown fields preserved in StoredNode (permissive)
- [ ] Exports are clean (no internal types leaked)

## References

- [[s-4l4m|Phase 1: Core Data Layer]]
- [SCHEMA.md](../docs/SCHEMA.md)

title: Implement ID generation and content hashing
content:
# Implement ID Generation

Hash-based ID generation following beads pattern.

## Deliverables

### `src/core/id.ts`

```typescript
// Main function
function generateId(type: NodeType, existingCount?: number): { id: string; uuid: string }

// Helpers
function typePrefix(type: string): string  // 's', 'i', 'f', 'e', 'x'
function adaptiveLength(count: number): number  // 4-8 based on collision probability
function toBase36(hash: Buffer): string
```

### `src/core/hash.ts`

```typescript
// Content hashing for dedup
function computeContentHash(node: StoredNode): string

// SHA256 helper
function sha256(input: string): string
```

### `src/core/index.ts`
- Re-export public functions

## Implementation Notes

- Use `crypto.randomUUID()` for UUID generation
- Use `crypto.createHash('sha256')` for hashing
- Base36 uses characters: 0-9, a-z (lowercase)
- Default to length 4 if existingCount not provided

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `generateId('issue')` returns `{ id: 'i-xxxx', uuid: '...' }`
- [ ] IDs are deterministic given same UUID (for testing)
- [ ] `adaptiveLength()` returns correct lengths per spec
- [ ] `computeContentHash()` excludes non-substantive fields
- [ ] Hash is stable (same input → same output)

## References

title: Define Storage interface
content:
# Define Storage Interface

Domain-driven storage interface following beads pattern.

## Deliverables

### `src/storage/interface.ts`

```typescript
interface Storage {
  // Nodes
  createNode(node: StoredNode, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  getNode(id: string): Promise<StoredNode | null>
  updateNode(id: string, updates: Partial<StoredNode>, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  deleteNode(id: string, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  queryNodes(filter: NodeFilter): Promise<StoredNode[]>
  
  // Edges
  createEdge(edge: Edge, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  getEdge(id: string): Promise<Edge | null>
  deleteEdge(id: string, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  getEdgesFrom(nodeId: string, type?: EdgeType): Promise<Edge[]>
  getEdgesTo(nodeId: string, type?: EdgeType): Promise<Edge[]>
  
  // Tags (join table operations)
  addTag(nodeId: string, tag: string, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  removeTag(nodeId: string, tag: string, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  getTags(nodeId: string): Promise<string[]>
  getTagsForNodes(nodeIds: string[]): Promise<Map<string, string[]>>
  getNodesByTag(tag: string): Promise<StoredNode[]>
  
  // Queries
  getReady(): Promise<StoredNode[]>
  
  // Transactions
  runInTransaction<T>(fn: (tx: Transaction) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>
  
  // Dirty tracking
  markDirty(nodeId: string): Promise<void>
  getDirtyNodes(): Promise<string[]>
  clearDirty(nodeIds: string[]): Promise<void>
  
  // Lifecycle
  close(): Promise<void>
}

interface Transaction {
  createNode(node: StoredNode, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  updateNode(id: string, updates: Partial<StoredNode>, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  createEdge(edge: Edge, actor?: string): Promise<void>
  addTag(nodeId: string, tag: string, actor?: string): Promise<void>
}

interface NodeFilter {
  type?: string | string[]
  status?: string | string[]
  tags?: string[]  // AND semantics
  parent_id?: string
  archived?: boolean
  search?: string
  limit?: number
  offset?: number
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Interface covers all operations from spec
- [ ] Transaction interface is subset of Storage
- [ ] NodeFilter supports all query patterns
- [ ] Types are strict (no `any`)

## References

- [[s-4l4m|Phase 1: Core Data Layer]]
- Beads: `references/beads/internal/storage/storage.go`

title: Implement JSONL Persister
content:
# Implement JSONL Persister

Git-friendly JSONL storage as source of truth.

## Deliverables

### `src/storage/jsonl.ts`

```typescript
interface JSONLPersisterConfig {
  path: string                  // e.g., ".opentasks/graph.jsonl"
  tombstonesPath?: string       // e.g., ".opentasks/tombstones.jsonl"
  atomicWrite?: boolean         // default: true
}

class JSONLPersister {
  constructor(config: JSONLPersisterConfig)
  
  // Load entire graph
  async load(): Promise<{ nodes: StoredNode[]; edges: Edge[] }>
  
  // Save entire graph (atomic write)
  async save(nodes: StoredNode[], edges: Edge[]): Promise<void>
  
  // Append single entry (for incremental writes)
  async append(entry: StoredNode | Edge): Promise<void>
  
  // Watch for external changes
  watch(callback: () => void): () => void  // returns unsubscribe
  
  // Check if file exists
  async exists(): Promise<boolean>
}
```

### Helper: `src/storage/atomic-write.ts`

```typescript
async function atomicWrite(path: string, content: string): Promise<void>
```

## Implementation Notes

- Use `fs.watch()` or `chokidar` for file watching
- Atomic write: write to temp file, then rename
- Temp file naming: `${path}.${process.pid}.tmp`
- Parse JSONL line-by-line (handle large files)
- Separate nodes from edges by checking `from_id` presence or id prefix

## File Format

```jsonl
{"id":"s-a2b3","uuid":"...","type":"spec","title":"...","tags":["auth"],...}
{"id":"i-x7k9","uuid":"...","type":"issue","title":"...","status":"open",...}
{"id":"x-r8s9","uuid":"...","from_id":"i-x7k9","to_id":"s-a2b3","type":"implements",...}
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `load()` parses JSONL correctly, separates nodes/edges
- [ ] `save()` uses atomic write (temp + rename)
- [ ] `append()` adds single line without rewriting file
- [ ] `watch()` detects external file changes
- [ ] Handles empty/missing file gracefully
- [ ] Preserves unknown fields (permissive)

## References

- [[s-4l4m|Phase 1: Core Data Layer]]
- Beads: `references/beads/internal/export/`

# Implement SQLite Persister

Fast query cache with better-sqlite3.

## Deliverables

### `src/storage/sqlite.ts`

```typescript
interface SQLitePersisterConfig {
  path: string                  // e.g., ".opentasks/cache.db"
  walMode?: boolean             // default: true
}

class SQLitePersister implements Storage {
  constructor(config: SQLitePersisterConfig)
  
  // Initialize database (create tables if needed)
  async initialize(): Promise<void>
  
  // Rebuild from JSONL (full import)
  async rebuildFromJsonl(jsonlPath: string): Promise<void>
  
  // All Storage interface methods...
}
```

### `src/storage/sqlite-schema.ts`

SQL schema as string constants for table creation.

## Schema

```sql
-- Nodes table
CREATE TABLE nodes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  uuid TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  content TEXT,
  content_hash TEXT,
  status TEXT,
  priority INTEGER,
  assignee TEXT,
  parent_id TEXT,
  source TEXT,
  archived INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_id TEXT,
  feedback_type TEXT,
  uri TEXT,
  materialized INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES nodes(id)
);

-- Tags join table
CREATE TABLE node_tags (
  node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  tag TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (node_id, tag),
  FOREIGN KEY (node_id) REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Edges table
CREATE TABLE edges (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  uuid TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  from_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_by TEXT,
  source TEXT
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_nodes_type ON nodes(type);
CREATE INDEX idx_nodes_status ON nodes(status);
CREATE INDEX idx_nodes_parent ON nodes(parent_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_nodes_archived ON nodes(archived);
CREATE INDEX idx_node_tags_tag ON node_tags(tag);
CREATE INDEX idx_edges_from ON edges(from_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_edges_to ON edges(to_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_edges_type ON edges(type);

-- Ready issues view
CREATE VIEW ready_issues AS
SELECT n.* FROM nodes n
WHERE n.type = 'issue'
  AND n.status = 'open'
  AND n.archived = 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM edges e
    JOIN nodes blocker ON e.from_id = blocker.id
    WHERE e.to_id = n.id
      AND e.type = 'blocks'
      AND blocker.status != 'closed'
      AND blocker.archived = 0
  );

-- Dirty tracking
CREATE TABLE dirty_nodes (
  node_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  marked_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Export hashes
CREATE TABLE export_hashes (
  node_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  content_hash TEXT NOT NULL
);
```

## Dependencies

Add to package.json:
```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "better-sqlite3": "^11.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/better-sqlite3": "^7.6.0"
  }
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `initialize()` creates all tables and indexes
- [ ] `rebuildFromJsonl()` imports full graph from JSONL
- [ ] Tag operations use join table correctly
- [ ] `getReady()` uses the view, returns correct issues
- [ ] `queryNodes()` builds correct WHERE clauses
- [ ] `runInTransaction()` properly commits/rollbacks
- [ ] Dirty tracking works (mark, get, clear)
- [ ] WAL mode enabled by default

## References

- [[s-4l4m|Phase 1: Core Data Layer]]
- Beads: `references/beads/internal/storage/sqlite/`

feedback.content:
## SQLite Persister Implementation Complete

### Requirements Met
- ✅ `initialize()` creates all tables and indexes
- ✅ `rebuildFromJsonl()` imports full graph from JSONL with tags
- ✅ Tag operations use join table correctly
- ✅ `getReady()` uses the view, returns correct issues
- ✅ `queryNodes()` builds correct WHERE clauses with all filters
- ✅ `runInTransaction()` properly commits (sync wrapper for better-sqlite3)
- ✅ Dirty tracking works (mark, get, clear)
- ✅ WAL mode enabled by default

### Design Decisions
- **Sync wrapper for transactions**: better-sqlite3 is synchronous, so transactions collect operations and execute them in a batch sync transaction
- **Boolean fields**: Stored as 0/1 integers, converted on read/write
- **Tags in getNode**: Tags are fetched separately and attached to node on retrieval
- **Tag filtering in queries**: Uses AND semantics (all tags must match)

### Files Created
- `src/storage/sqlite-schema.ts` - All SQL schema as string constants
- `src/storage/sqlite.ts` - Full `SQLitePersister` class implementing `Storage` interface
- `src/storage/__tests__/sqlite.test.ts` - 42 comprehensive tests

### Evidence
- 42 tests passing covering all operations (nodes, edges, tags, queries, ready view, transactions, dirty tracking)
